_note: Statutory ingredients for IPC offence sections whose ipc.json entry has none and which inherit none from a linked definition section. Paraphrased from the section text; status pending_review until checked by a lawyer. Applied only where ipc.json ingredients are empty. A trailing 'OR' marks alternatives, as in ipc.json.

304A: Causing the death of any person
By doing any rash or negligent act
The act does not amount to culpable homicide
305: Commission of suicide by a person under eighteen years of age, an insane or delirious person, an idiot, or a person in a state of intoxication
Abetment of that suicide by the accused (Section 107)
394: Committing or attempting to commit robbery (Section 390)
Voluntarily causing hurt in so committing or attempting it
The accused caused the hurt, or was jointly concerned in committing or attempting the robbery
396: Five or more persons conjointly committing dacoity (Section 391)
One of them commits murder in so committing dacoity
The accused was one of the persons conjointly committing the dacoity
397: At the time of committing it the offender uses a deadly weapon, causes grievous hurt, or attempts to cause death or grievous hurt
398: Attempting to commit robbery or dacoity
The offender is armed with a deadly weapon at the time of the attempt
407: Entrustment of property to the accused as a carrier, wharfinger or warehouse-keeper
Commission of criminal breach of trust (Section 405) in respect of that property
408: The accused is, or is employed as, a clerk or servant
Entrustment of property, or dominion over property, in that capacity
Commission of criminal breach of trust (Section 405) in respect of that property
409: The accused is a public servant, or a banker, merchant, factor, broker, attorney or agent
Entrustment of property, or dominion over property, in that capacity or in the way of that business
Commission of criminal breach of trust (Section 405) in respect of that property
416: By pretending to be some other person, knowingly substituting one person for another, or representing that he or another person is someone other than who he or that person really is
505: Making, publishing or circulating a statement, rumour or report
With intent to cause, or which is likely to cause, an officer or member of the armed forces to mutiny or disregard duty; OR
With intent to cause, or which is likely to cause, fear or alarm to the public inducing an offence against the State or public tranquillity; OR
With intent to incite, or which is likely to incite, any class or community to commit an offence against another
